course.title: Urban and Regional Economics
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose a fast growing city has a high housing demand while it allows only 40,000 units per year and the equilibrium price per unit in the inner city area is 10million BDT. Considering the demand, the city authority decides to expand housing supply by 30,000 additional units per year. Graphically explain the impact on the price change and estimate the monetary value of such permission.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
